top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's emergency preparedness plan was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A van used to transport children the child safety alarm on the vehicle was not working during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based upon the information gathered during the investigation, evidence was available to support safety precautions for loading and unloading children to ensure all children were accounted for was not followed.  As a result, a child was left on the van unattended.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

top_violation_types.title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that a child in care was left unattended in a vehicle owned and operated by the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a swing.
